caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately designed glass bowl centered on a beige background. The bowl has a scalloped rim and is decorated with alternating patterns of cross-hatched and smooth, curved segments, highlighted in shades of blue, white, and hints of pale yellow, giving the appearance of transparent and reflective glass. Below the bowl, to the left, there is a rectangular boxed inset featuring a top-down view of the same bowl, showing its symmetrical, divided sections that radiate outward from the center, matching the side view's design. The drawing is unsigned except for a small inscription reading "John Dana" in the lower right corner, along with a faint numerical scale just beneath the inset.
title: Salt Cellar
